summary: Official Hunan and Yongzhou sources establish a local property-registration custodian and unified registration platform, but no anonymous public parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries are recorded in city-10540-yongzhou.json. Results identified the official Yongzhou portal, Hunan service listing, Hunan Natural Resources Department report and Hunan unified property-registration portal.
requestOutcomes: The Yongzhou government portal loaded through public web access. The Hunan property-registration portal and Yongzhou natural-resources host timed out on bounded direct GET requests. Official service/procedure pages were available as first-party evidence but did not expose an anonymous parcel feature service. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields or TLS-disable action was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [26.4500537656399, 111.589910945635] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Yongzhou city boundary or complete city coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
Official registration custody/procedure evidence is not treated as proof of an open vector parcel API.
A timeout, inaccessible viewer, map extent miss or absent public endpoint is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
